name: STA314H1 — Deductive Derivation (Classification and Decision Trees)
description: Classification: predict discrete label. Logistic regression: P(Y=1|X)=1/(1+e^{-Xβ}). Decision boundary = where P=0.5. Linear boundary (in X). Can add

steps.template_en: Classification: predict discrete label. Logistic regression: P(Y=1|X)=1/(1+e^{-Xβ}). Decision boundary = where P=0.5. Linear boundary (in X). Can add polynomial terms for nonlinear boundaries.
steps.template_zh: 分类：预测离散标签。逻辑回归：P(Y=1|X)=1/(1+e^{-Xβ})。决策边界=P=0.5处。线性边界。加多项式项得非线性边界。

steps.template_en: Decision trees: recursive partition of predictor space. At each node: find split (variable + threshold) that minimizes impurity. Gini index: 1-Σpₖ². Entropy: -Σpₖlog pₖ. Both measure NODE PURITY.
steps.template_zh: 决策树：递归划分预测空间。每节点找最小化不纯度的分割。Gini指数：1-Σpₖ²。熵：-Σpₖlog pₖ。都度量节点纯度。

steps.template_en: Tree growing: until minimum node size or no impurity reduction. PRUNING: cut back to avoid overfitting. Cost-complexity pruning: minimize Σmisclassifications + α·|tree|. α chosen by CV.
steps.template_zh: 树生长：直到最小节点大小或无纯度改进。剪枝：剪回避免过拟合。成本复杂度剪枝：最小化误分类+α·|tree|。

steps.template_en: Random Forest: build B trees on bootstrap samples, at each split consider m random predictors. Aggregate by majority vote (classification) or average (regression). Reduces variance without increasing bias.
steps.template_zh: 随机森林：在B个bootstrap样本上建树，每分割考虑m个随机变量。多数投票(分类)或平均(回归)聚合。降低方差而不增偏差。

steps.template_en: On the iris dataset: (1) Fit a decision tree: rpart(Species~.). (2) Plot the tree. (3) Prune using cp parameter. (4) Fit random forest: randomForest(). (5) Compare accuracy vs logistic regression.
steps.template_zh: 在iris数据集上：(1)拟合决策树。(2)画树。(3)用cp剪枝。(4)拟合随机森林。(5)比较准确率vs逻辑回归。

steps.template_en: Trees are INTERPRETABLE but high variance. Random Forest: less interpretable but MUCH better accuracy. The key insight: DECORRELATE the trees by random feature selection → averaged predictions are stable and accurate.
steps.template_zh: 树可解释但高方差。随机森林：解释性略差但精度好很多。关键：随机选择特征使树去相关→平均预测稳定且准确。
